name: Vishal Sanwal
title: Software Developer | Full-Stack Web Developer
tagline: I build modern, responsive web applications and digital solutions that help businesses turn ideas into reliable products.
bio: I'm Vishal Sanwal, a software and full-stack web developer who builds practical, user-focused applications for the web.

I enjoy turning ideas into working products — from clean interfaces to reliable APIs and databases. My approach is straightforward: understand the goal, keep the architecture simple, and ship solutions that are maintainable.
I work on full-stack web apps, business websites, and freelance client projects. Whether it's a fitness tracker, a music player, or a storefront, I focus on clear UX and solid engineering.
availability: Open to freelance projects and full-time roles
